verdict.rationale: Hardware media engines are a fair question for a GPU, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only AI/HPC capabilities: HBM3e memory, MIG, confidential computing and LLM inference speedups. It never mentions AV1/HEVC encode/decode engines, creator-app acceleration, or professional/ISV-certified creator drivers. NVIDIA-Certified Systems refers to server platform certification, not creator ISV certification.
